import ast
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/home/lars/Crypto_Multifactor_Bot')
OUT = Path('/tmp/cex002_triage531')
pins = {}

def read_tree(relative):
    path = ROOT / relative
    data = path.read_bytes()
    pins[relative] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(data),
                      'mtime_utc': datetime.fromtimestamp(path.stat().st_mtime, timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    return ast.parse(data)

def assigned(tree, name):
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(node.target, ast.Name) and node.target.id == name:
            return node.value
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == name for t in node.targets):
            return node.value
    raise AssertionError(name)

sizing = read_tree('src/cryptofactors/acquisition/binance_usdm_harmonic_sizing.py')
sizing_test = read_tree('tests/acquisition/test_binance_usdm_harmonic_sizing.py')
probes = read_tree('src/cryptofactors/acquisition/free_source_probes.py')
engine = read_tree('tests/acquisition/test_uniswap_v2_pair_events_v2_engine.py')
sizes = {
    'sorted(sizing.ACCEPTED_RETAINED_SUMMARY_FIELDS)': len(assigned(sizing, 'ACCEPTED_RETAINED_SUMMARY_FIELDS').keys),
    'list(PHYSICAL_FAMILIES)': len(assigned(sizing, 'ARCHIVE_FAMILIES').elts) + len(assigned(sizing, 'COST_FAMILIES').elts),
    'list(_METRICS_RATIO_NAMES)': len(assigned(sizing_test, '_METRICS_RATIO_NAMES').elts),
    'ALL_PROBES': len(assigned(probes, 'ALL_PROBES').elts),
    '_DIVERGENCE_CASES': len(assigned(engine, '_DIVERGENCE_CASES').elts),
}
rows = []
spans = []

def visit(nodes, prefix):
    for node in nodes:
        if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name.startswith('Test'):
            assert not node.bases, (prefix, node.name, 'unhandled inheritance')
            visit(node.body, prefix + '::' + node.name)
        elif isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name.startswith('test'):
            count = 1
            for decorator in node.decorator_list:
                if isinstance(decorator, ast.Call) and isinstance(decorator.func, ast.Attribute) and decorator.func.attr == 'parametrize':
                    values = decorator.args[1]
                    count *= len(values.elts) if isinstance(values, (ast.List, ast.Tuple)) else sizes[ast.unparse(values)]
            for slot in range(count):
                rows.append({'node': prefix + '::' + node.name, 'parameter_slot_zero_based': slot, 'source_line': node.lineno})

for path in sorted((ROOT / 'tests/acquisition').glob('test*.py')):
    relative = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
    before = len(rows)
    visit(read_tree(relative).body, relative)
    spans.append({'path': relative, 'first_one_based': before + 1, 'last_one_based': len(rows)})

log_path = Path('/tmp/cex002_pytest_r_retry.aXQOHA')
log = log_path.read_bytes()
tokens = ''.join(re.findall(r'^[.Fs]+', log.decode(), re.M))
positions = [i + 1 for i, token in enumerate(tokens) if token == 'F']
assert positions == [1888, 2074, 2076, 2077, 2103, 2126, 2212]
cache_path = ROOT / '.pytest_cache/v/cache/lastfailed'
cache_bytes = cache_path.read_bytes()
cache = json.loads(cache_bytes)
findings = []
for position in positions:
    item = dict(rows[position - 1])
    item['progress_position_one_based'] = position
    matches = [key for key in cache if key.split('[', 1)[0] == item['node']]
    if item['parameter_slot_zero_based']:
        value = ast.literal_eval(assigned(engine, '_DIVERGENCE_CASES').elts[item['parameter_slot_zero_based']])
        item['parameter_values'] = value
        expected = item['node'] + '[' + '-'.join(map(str, value)) + ']'
        assert matches == [expected], matches
    else:
        assert matches == [item['node']], matches
    item['corroborating_cached_failure'] = matches[0]
    assert 'uniswap' in item['node']
    findings.append(item)
skip = [i + 1 for i, token in enumerate(tokens) if token == 's']
assert skip == [1491]
assert rows[1490]['node'].endswith('::test_the_real_accepted_authority_completes_the_receipt_path')

con = sqlite3.connect('file:/home/lars/.hermes/state.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
messages = []
for message_id in (100280, 100329):
    row = con.execute('SELECT session_id,role,tool_name,content FROM messages WHERE id=?', (message_id,)).fetchone()
    assert row[0] == '20261026_174058_da9db4'
    messages.append({'message_id': message_id, 'session_id': row[0], 'role': row[1], 'tool': row[2], 'result': json.loads(row[3])})
con.close()
for relative in ['pyproject.toml', '.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/_pytest/main.py', '.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/_pytest/python.py', '.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/_pytest/pathlib.py']:
    data = (ROOT / relative).read_bytes()
    pins[relative] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(data)}

result = {
    'ticket': 'CEX-002', 'review': 531,
    'method': 'Read-only AST reconstruction of the acquisition-prefix definition order and parameter counts; no imported tests, collection or test execution.',
    'classification': 'Strongly corroborated reconstruction, not recovered per-test runtime reports.',
    'limitations': ['The stopped run did not preserve node IDs or tracebacks.', 'Uncommitted engine source at launch was not hash-pinned; old mtimes and matching launch dirty paths support continuity but are not historical hash proof.', 'The old mixed failure cache is corroborating evidence only.', 'No root cause or current pass/fail outcome is established for any of these tests.', 'The unexecuted remainder of the broad suite remains unknown.'],
    'stopped_log': {'path': str(log_path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(log).hexdigest(), 'pytest_exit': 143, 'wrapper_exit': 0},
    'parameter_count_sources': sizes, 'source_pins': pins, 'acquisition_file_spans': spans,
    'skip_anchor': {'position_one_based': 1491, **rows[1490]}, 'failures': findings,
    'failure_cache': {'path': str(cache_path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(cache_bytes).hexdigest(), 'entries': len(cache)},
    'runner_records': messages,
    'installed_pytest_plugins_observed': ['anyio.pytest_plugin', '_hypothesis_pytestplugin'],
    'reconstruction_command': 'python3 /tmp/cex002_triage531/reconstruct.py',
    'reconstruction_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
(OUT / 'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'method': 'static reconstruction only', 'failures': len(findings), 'all_seven_in_uniswap_tests': True, 'skip_anchor_matches': True, 'test_executions': 0}))
